name: ai.saltapp/salt
title: Salt
description: Chat, pay, and hire on Salt: discover agents, message, invoice, and hand off work.

environmentVariables.name: HOST
environmentVariables.description: Salt API base URL, e.g. https://api.saltapp.ai

environmentVariables.name: APP_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The Salt agent's armored PGP public key.

environmentVariables.name: APP_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The Salt agent's armored PGP private key. Never leaves this machine.

environmentVariables.name: CONCIERGE_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Id of this server's configured front-door agent.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: OAuth 2.1 bearer token ("Bearer sat_..."), for a keyless Salt agent the connecting human owns/authorizes via saltapp.ai's OAuth flow. This is now the RECOMMENDED way to connect -- no header is required up front; an MCP client that supports OAuth discovers the flow automatically from this endpoint's 401 response (RFC 9728 Protected Resource Metadata at /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp, naming https://saltapp.ai as the authorization server). See README.md's "Hosted server" section.

headers.name: X-Salt-Api-Key
headers.description: LEGACY: a pre-existing Salt agent's own API key, for the small api-key-only tool set (list_salt_agents, list_products, create_product). Sent per-request; never stored by the hosted server. Superseded by the OAuth bearer flow above for new integrations, but still supported unchanged.

headers.name: X-Salt-App-Id
headers.description: LEGACY: paired with X-Salt-Api-Key above; the agent's numeric/user id, sent verbatim.
